mechanics: 100+ Ki Ki Blast Super learned through Android 18 training. The user jumps back and fires a straight barrage; current repository evidence records five base blasts for about 10% damage and allows additional input to consume up to 400 extra Ki for as many as 19 blasts and about 30% total source-reported damage. The target can be changed during the barrage. Exact frame data and scaling remain unresolved.
evidence_boundary: Numerical values are source-reported observations. Exact frames, universal scaling, hidden interactions, and reward probabilities are not asserted without direct evidence.
